eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN IMMEDIATE EVACUATION NOTICE for the following counties or areas: Lassen, CA; at 8:36 PM on AUG 16, 2021 Effective until 8:36 PM AUG 17, 2021. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text:
A NEW MANDATORY EVACUATION ORDER HAS BEEN ISSUED FOR east of Hwy 395 from Standish Buntingville Rd south to the Milford Grade intersection and north to Baxter Creek

Use A-3 as an exit route.  Shelter is at Lassen College.  If you need assistance evacuating call dispatch at 530-257-6121.
